headline: Seduta in prevalenza negativa a Wall Street: Sandisk +11,90% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly negative session on Wall Street: Sandisk +11.90% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 4 settembre 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 174 societa' in rialzo, 328 in ribasso e 1 invariate, su 503 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di -0,53%.

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Industrials (+0,28%); Utilities (+0,08%); Materials (-0,30%). Settori piu' debolli: Communication Services (-1,55%); Health Care (-0,92%); Financials (-0,87%).

In cima alla seduta: Sandisk (SNDK, +11,90%); KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7,32%), dove CNBC riporta: «Final Trades: FTAI Aviation, KLA Corp, Nvidia and Oracle»; Marvell Technology (MRVL, +7,05%), dove WSJ riporta: «Marvell Lifts Long-Term Targets as AI Demand Boosts Second-Quarter Profit, Revenue». In fondo: Amphenol (APH, -47,79%); Lululemon Athletica (LULU, -17,38%), dove Barron's riporta: «Lululemon Stock Has Plunged. Why It Faces a Long Road to Recovery.»; Fair Isaac (FICO, -16,68%), dove Barron's riporta: «FICO Parent Fair Isaac and Credit Bureaus Sink. Bill Pulte Is Behind the Drop.».

manual_commentary_html_en:
U.S. stocks closed lower on September 4, 2026, as a robust jobs report shifted market sentiment toward higher interest rates. The economy added 162,000 jobs in August, a figure described by the Wall Street Journal as a bright spot that nonetheless fueled hawkish Federal Reserve bets. The report sent short-term Treasury yields climbing and weighed on equities broadly, with the S&P 500 declining 0.53 percent and the Dow Jones falling 0.61 percent. The Nasdaq-100 proved more resilient, rising 0.09 percent despite the broader selloff, as technology stocks outperformed the wider market.

Technology stocks led gains, averaging 2.7 percent and anchoring the session's modest breadth advantage in the Nasdaq-100. Semiconductor and memory-chip makers dominated the gainers list. Marvell Technology climbed 7.05 percent after lifting long-term targets as AI demand boosted second-quarter profit and revenue, according to the Wall Street Journal. Micron Technology advanced 6.1 percent as it doubled down on AI memory chips, per MarketWatch. KLA Corporation gained 7.32 percent following coverage from CNBC, while Sandisk, Astera Labs, Seagate Technology, and Western Digital all posted gains of 5.86 to 11.9 percent, though tracked outlets reported no specific catalysts for most of these moves. Nebius Group rose 7.48 percent, with Barron's noting the stock should find a floor at current levels.

Communication Services, Health Care, and Consumer Staples were the session's worst performers, declining 1.55, 0.89, and 0.87 percent respectively. Amphenol suffered the steepest loss, plunging 47.79 percent with no reported company catalyst. Lululemon Athletica fell 17.38 percent as Barron's assessed a long road to recovery ahead for the apparel retailer. Fair Isaac dropped 16.68 percent, with Barron's attributing the decline to Bill Pulte's involvement with the company and credit bureaus.
